name: hide_party_status_ui

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_HidePartyStatusUi takes no Script context, sets bit 3 of D_002C1EA8, and does not access the value stack

notes: The registered interface callback func_0023E2B8 observes D_002C1EA8 bit 3 and transitions each of the three indexed party-status components through func_0023E0B0 to hidden state 3. Clearing the bit through command 112 sends the same components to display state 2.
